Class OrderService

java.lang.Object
am.gortsup.testing.service.OrderService
public class OrderService extends Object
Service managing customer order lifecycle, payment processing, shipping, and cancellations.

  • Method Details

    • createOrder

      public Order createOrder(String userId, List<CartItem> items, Address shippingAddress, double taxRatePercentage, Coupon coupon)
      Creates an order from cart items.
      Parameters:
      userId - customer identifier
      items - non-empty list of items
      shippingAddress - destination address
      taxRatePercentage - tax rate percentage (0.0 to 100.0)
      coupon - optional coupon applied to order
      Returns:
      created Order in PENDING status
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if arguments are invalid or items list is empty

    • payOrder

      public void payOrder(String orderId, String cardNumber, double amount)
      Processes payment for a pending order using credit card.
      Parameters:
      orderId - order identifier
      cardNumber - credit card number (must pass Luhn algorithm check)
      amount - payment amount (must exactly match order total)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if order does not exist
      IllegalOrderStateException - if order is not in PENDING status
      PaymentFailedException - if card fails Luhn check or amount does not match

    • shipOrder

      public void shipOrder(String orderId, String trackingNumber)
      Dispatches an order for delivery.
      Parameters:
      orderId - order identifier
      trackingNumber - non-empty tracking code
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if order does not exist
      ValidationException - if trackingNumber is null/empty
      IllegalOrderStateException - if order is not in PAID or PROCESSING status

    • deliverOrder

      public void deliverOrder(String orderId)
      Marks an in-transit order as delivered to the customer.
      Parameters:
      orderId - order identifier
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if order does not exist
      IllegalOrderStateException - if order status is not SHIPPED

    • cancelOrder

      public void cancelOrder(String orderId)
      Cancels an order. Orders can only be cancelled before they are shipped.
      Parameters:
      orderId - order identifier
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if order does not exist
      IllegalOrderStateException - if order is already SHIPPED, DELIVERED, or CANCELLED

    • refundOrder

      public void refundOrder(String orderId, double refundAmount)
      Issues a refund for an order.
      Parameters:
      orderId - order identifier
      refundAmount - amount to refund (must be > 0 and invalid input: '<'= order total)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if order does not exist
      IllegalOrderStateException - if order was never paid
      ValidationException - if refundAmount is invalid input: '<'= 0 or exceeds order total
